title: Activation funnel baseline metrics (signup → key created → first success → D7 retention) — by segment & region
content:
Activation funnel baseline (PRE-sprint)
Owner: Mei Lin (Growth KPI pipelines)
Last refresh: 2025-01-21

Time window
- Signups cohort window: 2024-12-15 to 2025-01-07 (so D7 can fully mature through 2025-01-21)
- Includes: self-serve signups (email + OAuth) for Hosted API (Console)
- Excludes: internal @redwoodinference.com, known QA/test tenants, docs/quickstart synthetic monitors

Core definitions (baseline)
- signup: first successful account creation (auth DB) with a verified email OR OAuth completion
- key_created: first API key created in Console (control-plane event)
- first_success: first successful inference call (HTTP 2xx) to any supported inference endpoint (API logs). NOTE: streaming success is NOT required for baseline.
- D7_retained: at least 1 successful inference call between day 7 and day 13 after signup (inclusive), same workspace

Caveat: region is derived from first successful inference request region when available; if no first_success, falls back to signup IP geo (lower confidence).

====================================================================================================================
TABLE 1 — Baseline funnel by segment x region (cohort-level counts and conversions)
====================================================================================================================
Columns:
Segment | Region | Signups | Key created (#) | Key created (%) | First success (#) | First success (% of signups) | First success (% of key) | D7 retained (#) | D7 retained (% of signups) | D7 retained (% of first success) | Median time to key | Median time to first success | Notes

OVERALL | ALL | 8,420 | 5,162 | 61.3% | 3,224 | 38.3% | 62.5% | 1,456 | 17.3% | 45.2% | 6m | 19m | Overall baseline prior to lifecycle sprint changes

Self-serve (new) | NA | 2,180 | 1,512 | 69.4% | 1,012 | 46.4% | 66.9% | 512 | 23.5% | 50.6% | 5m | 16m | Best-performing cohort; higher docs/SDK usage
Self-serve (new) | EU | 1,420 | 904 | 63.7% | 564 | 39.7% | 62.4% | 242 | 17.0% | 42.9% | 6m | 21m | Slightly lower success; more auth/config support tickets
Self-serve (new) | APAC | 860 | 462 | 53.7% | 276 | 32.1% | 59.7% | 104 | 12.1% | 37.7% | 8m | 27m | Higher latency + more timeouts reported; more Python-only users

Self-serve (returning to Redwood; new workspace) | NA | 690 | 416 | 60.3% | 302 | 43.8% | 72.6% | 150 | 21.7% | 49.7% | 7m | 14m | Good key→success; key creation drop suggests confusion re: org/workspace
Self-serve (returning to Redwood; new workspace) | EU | 420 | 230 | 54.8% | 150 | 35.7% | 65.2% | 60 | 14.3% | 40.0% | 9m | 20m | Region mapping lower confidence due to more “no-first-success” rows
Self-serve (returning to Redwood; new workspace) | APAC | 180 | 84 | 46.7% | 48 | 26.7% | 57.1% | 12 | 6.7% | 25.0% | 11m | 33m | Small N; high variance

Open-source/Community (from GitHub referrals) | NA | 780 | 460 | 59.0% | 292 | 37.4% | 63.5% | 126 | 16.2% | 43.2% | 6m | 22m | Attribution is directional (referrer not always present)
Open-source/Community (from GitHub referrals) | EU | 510 | 278 | 54.5% | 170 | 33.3% | 61.2% | 64 | 12.5% | 37.6% | 7m | 26m | More curl-only usage; fewer SDK events
Open-source/Community (from GitHub referrals) | APAC | 260 | 116 | 44.6% | 74 | 28.5% | 63.8% | 20 | 7.7% | 27.0% | 10m | 31m | Frequent “model not found” / default model confusion in logs

High-intent (added billing within 72h) | NA | 220 | 190 | 86.4% | 174 | 79.1% | 91.6% | 122 | 55.5% | 70.1% | 3m | 9m | Strong cohort; often hits higher rate limits quickly
High-intent (added billing within 72h) | EU | 120 | 96 | 80.0% | 82 | 68.3% | 85.4% | 50 | 41.7% | 61.0% | 4m | 11m | Small N; tends to be “already have use case” users
High-intent (added billing within 72h) | APAC | 40 | 30 | 75.0% | 24 | 60.0% | 80.0% | 12 | 30.0% | 50.0% | 5m | 13m | Very small N

Lapsed signups (no key created within 7d) | NA | 980 | 0 | 0.0% | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | n/a | n/a | Used for retargeting audiences; see data-quality notes on suppression
Lapsed signups (no key created within 7d) | EU | 720 | 0 | 0.0% | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | n/a | n/a | 
Lapsed signups (no key created within 7d) | APAC | 270 | 0 | 0.0% | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | 0 | 0.0% | n/a | n/a | n/a | 

How to interpret
- Biggest drop is signup → key_created (overall 61%). Key creation is the most addressable step via Console checklist + email CTAs.
- Key_created → first_success is relatively strong (62.5% overall), but materially worse in APAC.
- D7 retention among activated users is ~45% overall; best cohort is billing-added within 72h (70%).

====================================================================================================================
TABLE 2 — Top failure reasons observed before first_success (from API logs + Support tags; directional)
====================================================================================================================
Failure reason | Share of “no first_success” (est.) | Notes / sample strings
Auth/API key missing/invalid | 28% | “401 invalid_api_key”, “No API key provided”, users using org-level keys in wrong workspace
Model selection confusion | 17% | “model not found”, wrong model ID copied from docs/old examples
Request formatting / SDK mismatch | 16% | wrong base URL, missing required fields, older SDK examples, JSON shape errors
Rate limit / quota confusion | 9% | particularly after free credits exhausted; some 429s
Streaming disconnects/timeouts | 8% | mostly shows as “client disconnected”; baseline first_success does not require streaming
Networking/VPN/proxy | 6% | enterprise proxies, TLS intercept edge cases
Other/unknown | 16% | includes missing logging fields and low-signal errors

====================================================================================================================
Data quality gaps / known issues (baseline)
====================================================================================================================
1) Region attribution confidence
- For users without first_success, region is inferred from signup IP; accuracy is lower for VPN/proxy.
- Action: after ENG-2841/PR_8932, capture region consistently on key_created + first_request_success events.

2) first_success coverage across endpoints
- Some embeddings traffic routes through older path that wasn’t consistently tagged with workspace_id in logs (impacts join).
- Action: Logan to confirm schema validation + required properties across inference endpoints (workspace_id, route_id, sdk, region).

3) D7 retention window maturity and timezone
- Cohort cutoff used above (2025-01-07) is deliberate; earlier drafts mistakenly included recent signups which undercounted D7.
- Retention computed in UTC; users experience local time (minor boundary effects).

4) Bots / low-quality signups
- Spikes from disposable email domains show low key_created rates; filtered internal, but not filtering all disposable domains yet.
- Action: add “suspected_bot” heuristic tag for analysis slices (do NOT use for product decisions without review).

5) Console vs API mismatch for “key created”
- A small number of workspaces create keys via API/automation; these may not emit the same console event.
- Action: unify to a single canonical key_created event emitted server-side.

6) Support tagging inconsistencies
- Support tags are not consistently applied; Table 2 is directional only.
- Action: Dev Patel to align Support macros with sprint taxonomy (auth/model/streaming/billing).

====================================================================================================================
Notes for sprint instrumentation & dashboards (what we need for experiment readout)
====================================================================================================================
- Ensure the primary activation metric is stable: recommend “first_request_success (2xx) within 72h of signup” + report streaming success as secondary.
- Required breakdowns for readout: segment (new vs returning), region, SDK (python/typescript/curl/other), and acquisition channel when available.
- Add explicit “time_to_first_success” percentiles (p50/p75/p90), not just median.
- Guardrails to monitor alongside baseline shifts: unsubscribe rate, support-link click spikes, console performance (LCP), and error banner CTR.

Open questions / TODO
- Confirm whether we treat “D7 retained” as any inference event OR “≥ X tokens generated” threshold to reduce noise.
- Decide on canonical segment definitions (e.g., “returning” = prior workspace OR prior API token usage) and lock for sprint readout.

Change log
- 2025-01-21: updated cohort cutoff to allow full D7 maturity; added high-intent (billing-added) segment.
- 2025-01-14: initial baseline pull shared in #marketing + #product for sprint kickoff.
